<script total>

	exports.id = 'contactform';
	exports.name = 'Contact form';
	exports.author = 'Peter Širka | Total.js';
	exports.version = '1';
	exports.group = 'Forms';
	exports.config = {};
	exports.preview = 'data:image/gif;base64,';
	exports.render = function(opt, next) {
		let index = opt.body.indexOf('<b>') + 3;
		let subject = opt.body.substring(index, opt.body.indexOf('</b>', index));
		let cls = [];
		if (opt.body.includes('CMS_mv'))
			cls.push('CMS_mv');
		if (opt.body.includes('CMS_mh'))
			cls.push('CMS_mh');
		if (cls.length)
			cls.unshift('');
		next('<div class="contactform{0}" data-subject="{1}" data-api="{2}">{3}</div>'.format(cls.join(' '), subject, CONF.$api, opt.template), true, true);
	};

</script>

<style>

	.CMS_preview .CLASS-content { padding: 20px; background-color: #FFFED1; border-radius: var(--radius); outline: 2px solid var(--color); }
	.CMS_preview .CLASS-name { font-size: 17px; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 10px; }

	.contactform { margin-bottom: 20px; }
	.contactform button { border: 0; margin: 15px 0 0; min-width: 200px; background-color: #F0F0F0; height: 45px; padding: 0 20px; color: #000; cursor: pointer; font-family: Arial; line-height: 45px; vertical-align: middle; outline: 0; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.3s; }
	.contactform button i { width: 15px; text-align: center; margin-right: 5px; }
	.contactform button:hover { opacity: 0.8; }
	.contactform button:active { background-color: #D0D0D0; }
	.contactform button:disabled { background-color: #F5F5F5 !important; border-color: #E0E0E0 !important; color: silver !important; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; }
	.contactform button:disabled i { color: silver !important; }
	.contactform button:first-child { border-top-left-radius: var(--radius); border-bottom-left-radius: var(--radius); }
	.contactform button:last-child { border-top-right-radius: var(--radius); border-bottom-right-radius: var(--radius); }
	.contactform button[name='submit'] { font-weight: bold; background-color: var(--color); color: #FFF; }
	.contactform .success { color: #68B25B; font-size: 14px; border: 2px solid #68B25B; padding: 10px; border-radius: var(--radius); display: block; }
	.contactform .success i { margin-right: 5px; }
	.contactform .error { color: #E8483F; font-size: 14px; border: 2px solid #E8483F; padding: 10px; border-radius: var(--radius); display: block; }
	.contactform .error i { margin-right: 5px; }

</style>

<body>
	<div class="CLASS-content">
		<div class="CLASS-name"><i class="ti ti-envelope mr5"></i><b class="CMS_edit">Contact form</b></div>
		<div class="CMS_input">Name</div>
		<div class="CMS_input">E-mail</div>
		<div class="CMS_input">Message</div>
	</div>
</body>

<template>

	<h2>Contact form</h2>

	<ui-plugin path="? contactform">
		<ui-bind path="?.success" config="show" class="hidden success">
			<i class="ti ti-check-circle"></i><b>Thank you.</b> The form has been submitted successfully.
		</ui-bind>
		<ui-bind path="?.success" config="hide" class="hidden">
			<ui-component class="m" name="input" path="?.name" config="required:1">Name</ui-component>
			<ui-component class="m" name="input" path="?.email" config="required:1;type:email">E-mail</ui-component>
			<ui-component class="m" name="input" path="?.body" config="required:1;type:multiline">Message</ui-component>
			<ui-bind path="?.error" config="template;show" class="hidden error">
				<script type="text/html">
					{{ foreach m in value }}
					<div><i class="ti ti-warning"></i>{{ m.error }}</div>
					{{ end }}
				</script>
			</ui-bind>
			<ui-component name="validate" path="?">
				<button name="submit" class="exec" data-exec="?/submit" disabled><i class="ti ti-envelope"></i>SUBMIT</button>
			</ui-component>
		</ui-bind>
	</ui-plugin>

	<script>
		PLUGIN('contactform', function(exports) {
			exports.submit = function() {
				let api = ATTRD(exports.element, 'api');
				let model = exports.form;
				model.subject = ATTRD(exports.element, 'subject');
				API(api, 'ContactForms|create', model, function(response) {
					if (ERROR(response))
						exports.set('error', response);
					else
						exports.set('success', true);
				});
			};
		});
	</script>

</template>
